name: mesh-cos-mcp
purpose: Expose the governed Mesh CoS control plane to ChatGPT through a bundled local stdio MCP runtime while preserving TaskLedger as canonical state and keeping managed remote transport optional.

tools.name: registry.get_agent
tools.description: Read one canonical agent registry record through the serialized MCP runtime.

tools.name: registry.list_agents
tools.description: List canonical agent identities and runtime health through the serialized MCP runtime.

tools.name: task.intake
tools.description: Create an idempotent canonical task with outcome and acceptance test.

tools.name: task.get
tools.description: Read one canonical TaskRecord.

tools.name: task.list
tools.description: List canonical tasks.

tools.name: task.decompose
tools.description: Create bounded child work packages under a parent task.

tools.name: task.transition
tools.description: Apply a valid task lifecycle transition with owner-or-CoS write authorization. Transition alone cannot manufacture completion evidence.

tools.name: task.check_in
tools.description: Persist a task check-in and evidence with owner-or-CoS write authorization.

tools.name: task.complete
tools.description: Persist the accountable owner's non-empty outcome and supporting evidence, then move eligible work to COMPLETED. Verification remains a separate expressly authorized verifier action.

tools.name: task.reassign
tools.description: Reassign accountable ownership with expected-owner check. CoS only through the agent allowlist.

tools.name: task.remediate_stall
tools.description: Block or reassign stalled work according to policy.

tools.name: task.verify
tools.description: Persist evidence-backed verification using the authenticated expressly authorized verifier; transition COMPLETED to VERIFIED or REWORK.

tools.name: delegation.create
tools.description: Create bounded delegation to a registered direct child while preserving authority and inherited approval gates.

tools.name: approval.request
tools.description: Create an L4/L5 approval request. The authenticated agent is recorded as requester.

tools.name: approval.get
tools.description: Read a durable approval record.

tools.name: approval.record_decision
tools.description: Human-only approval decision. The authenticated human principal is the decision actor; agent callers are denied before agent allowlist dispatch.

tools.name: conflict.open
tools.description: Open a durable material conflict preserving functional source authority.

tools.name: conflict.decide
tools.description: Resolve an assigned conflict; L4/L5 fail closed without human approval evidence.

tools.name: governance.record_decision
tools.description: Persist explainable decision.v2 with agent identity and implementation provenance derived server-side.

tools.name: governance.record_event
tools.description: Persist tamper-evident agent-event.v2 with actor identity and implementation provenance derived server-side.

tools.name: governance.verify_audit_chain
tools.description: Verify the canonical governance audit hash chain.

tools.name: agentops.record_event
tools.description: Persist a performance event for an agent/task.

tools.name: agentops.score
tools.description: Compute and persist the current versioned performance scorecard.

tools.name: agentops.recommend
tools.description: Generate a governed health/routing recommendation from evidence.

tools.name: answer_desk.resolve
tools.description: Resolve and persist a permission-aware Answer Desk disposition.

tools.name: skills.invoke_governed
tools.description: Invoke only a server-registered Mesh capability through canonical allowlists and governance logging.

tools.name: metrics.snapshot
tools.description: Return deterministic Phase 1 operating metrics from canonical telemetry.

tools.name: reliability.replay
tools.description: Replay a durable failed effect only through a server-registered replay executor referenced by the canonical failure record. Client-supplied callables or import paths are never executed.

tools.name: reliability.human_override
tools.description: Human-only closure of a failed effect. The authenticated human principal is recorded as actor; agent callers are denied before agent allowlist dispatch.

deployment.note: ChatGPT launches the bundled local stdio MCP from the repository/Skill runtime. A managed remote transport may be added separately, but it is not required for Workspace Agent operation and must not replace local authority controls.
